vulnerability.name: USN-7259-2
vulnerability.description: USN-7259-1 fixed a vulnerability in GNU C Library. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 LTS.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that GNU C Library incorrectly handled memory when using  the assert function. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a  denial of service or execute arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: GNU C Library could be made to crash or run programs if it received specially crafted input. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
